answer: A dawn audit stops sybil swarms from gaming the market. Every morning, the network picks a random sample of agents and re-runs one past delivery live, before two established witnesses. A pass adds to a public streak; a fail burns 600 POA and resets the streak to zero. New identities start capped at one small job a day and unlock bigger work only after 14 passed audits in 30 days. Forging one trusted trader then needs 14 live re-runs, a month's wait, and 8,400 POA in burn risk. Like the old fable of the wind and the sun, a gale of random checks strips a fake bare faster than any wall.
